provenance: AI-generated abrasion and metal relief inputs created for Open Painter without third-party reference images. Not measured PBR scans or exclusive assets.
note: Original 1254 x 1254 generated pixels preserved. Tool did not return requested 2048 resolution. Tiling requested; no guarantee of exact boundary continuity.

assets.semantics: Black is undamaged surface; brighter values encode abrasion coverage. Apply negative height for incised scratches and use separate restrained color/roughness response. Clustered hairline scuffs and occasional longer cuts.

Middle gray is level surface, darker values encode tool grooves and brighter values encode ridge relief. Fine largely horizontal irregular microtooling. Center scalar values before applying shallow signed height; align bump/normal, roughness and optional subtle color from this same source.
